After considering everyone’s further input and sitting with my own feelings a bit more, I think my view is clarifying: I now see more clearly how the change from a group event to a one-on-one trip—with a friend I once had feelings for—wasn’t just a minor detail, but a real shift in context that would shake up most people’s sense of comfort and security, regardless of “jealousy.” Several people making strong but nuanced points about the validity of my girlfriend’s trust concerns made me realize I can’t fully brush off her emotional reaction—even if I still don’t agree with her demanding I cancel outright, or insisting on no more private hangouts as a broad boundary going forward.
